a fact worthy of attention

definition: an important, honorable person (word is often used humorously)
examples: he told his story to some conservative worthies
local worthies rarely challenged the chief constable

definition: marked by spirited enjoyment
having an agreeably pungent taste
very large indeterminate number
examples: a zillion people were there

definition: a very large indefinite number (usually hyperbole)
examples: there were millions of flies

definition: concerning the study of animals and their classification and properties
examples: zoological research

definition: of or relating to animals or animal groups
examples: zoological garden
